title: Planck says inflation, dark energy, and dark matter are not understood at a fundamental level
summary: The collaboration's own conclusions say the main ingredients of ΛCDM are not understood fundamentally, even while the fit describes the data.
body: The conclusions of Planck 2018 results VI say that the base-ΛCDM model describes the Universe from times prior to 380 000 years after the Big Bang to the present day, and then say it is important to bear in mind that the main ingredients of ΛCDM, namely inflation, dark energy, and dark matter, are not understood at any fundamental level. That is the collaboration's assessment of the state of understanding. It is not a measurement, and it is not a rejection of the fit. The fit parameters are on the other Planck cards.
